findings.description: The woman's torso emerges from the hood at the near-side cowl, outside the windshield (cabin seats and windshield glass visible behind her) yet with the hood and near fender continuing uninterrupted beneath her crossed arms. There is no physical space for a standing body there — her lower body would have to be inside the engine bay. She is neither inside the cabin nor standing beside the fender (no body occluding the fender/wood panel). The impossible placement persists through the entire push-in.

Between ~3.5s and ~4.5-5.0s the car's orientation in frame is nearly unchanged, but the background directly behind the hood changes from an open desert scrub field with only a road edge at far left to a straight two-lane highway with yellow center dashes receding to a vanishing point, plus telephone poles that were absent earlier. The modest camera move does not account for the road swinging into the region previously occupied by scrubland.
